name: D-FINE (HGNetV2, N / S / M / L / X)
plain: D-FINE (N, S, M, L, X; HGNetV2, COCO) from USTC: real-time end-to-end detector in the RT-DETR style, 300 queries, deformable attention and box edges refined as distributions, no NMS. Also DEIM (N, S, M, L, X): the same network with SiLU decoder MLPs, trained with dense one-to-one matching.
summary: D-FINE (Peng et al. 2025, USTC): real-time end-to-end detection like RT-DETR (HGNetV2 backbone, hybrid encoder, deformable-attention decoder over 300 selected queries, no NMS) whose decoder layers refine every box edge as a distribution over distances (fine-grained distribution refinement); boxes, scores and COCO classes at the input size. The portable `module()` is the whole network at 640x640 (class logits and normalised boxes).

papers.title: D-FINE: Redefine Regression Task in DETRs as Fine-grained Distribution Refinement

official.reason: The benchmarked original is the Hugging Face transformers port (DFineForObjectDetection), which loads the same weights; the repo itself was not run.

limitations: The original in the benchmarks and goldens is the Hugging Face transformers 5.19.0 port (DFineForObjectDetection, ustc-community weights) of the official D-FINE (Apache-2.0); the official repository code itself was not run.

deim-* variants: DEIM (Huang et al. 2025), the D-FINE network with SiLU decoder MLPs, trained with dense one-to-one matching; weights and the original in the benchmarks are from the official DEIM repository (@09d35d53).
task_io: Input: one RGB image. Output: boxes, class labels, scores and instance masks.
